name: Defence
starterScope: Authenticated, owner-scoped CRUD register with search, export and audit history.
extensions: Unclassified synthetic data only. No targeting, weapons control or classified system integrations.
acceptanceCriteria: Anonymous requests cannot read private records.
Users can create, edit, search, export and delete their own records.
Other users cannot read or mutate these records.
State changes are recorded in audit history.
